resources.string: Ok, I give up. You\'re a clinical case. 💀

string-array.name: insults_phase_1
string-array.item: Want to be insulted? Easy: you\'re still there.
Your boss doesn\'t love you. Your couch does.
Congrats: you\'ve turned your desk into your home address.
You\'re working for free. FREE. Say it out loud.
Even the coffee machine has a better social life than you.
Your laptop is tired. At least it has an excuse.
You\'re the only one answering emails at 8 PM. The only one.
You\'re trading your life for a spreadsheet.

string-array.name: insults_phase_2
string-array.item: Nobody, in the end, ever said: \"I wish I\'d answered more emails\".
Your plants are dead. So is your social life.
Your paycheck doesn\'t even know your name.
The company would replace you in a week. You\'ve already lost three weekends.
Your friends stopped inviting you. Now you know why.
Your boss is already home. Laughing at you.
You have more work chats than friends. Way more.
When you retire they\'ll get you a cake. From the discount store.

string-array.name: insults_phase_3
string-array.item: CLOSE. THAT. LAPTOP.
YOU. ARE. STILL. THERE. WHY.
An app is yelling at you. You\'ve hit rock bottom.
Last chance, then I\'m calling your mother.
STOP. NOW. THIS IS NOT A SUGGESTION.
Work martyr: nobody will build you a statue. Nobody.
You\'re losing. To a phone. Shameful.
ENOUGH. Even I have limits. And you crossed them.
